verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents its REST endpoints as human-readable reference pages, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found all standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returning 404. The llms.txt file is LLM-oriented documentation, not a machine-readable API specification, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
